Z:\claude-sota\.claude\rules\synthesis-layer-verify.md:40:- **OVER (transcript-vs-report)**: agent's `verdict_one_line` claims `DONE: 5 fixes` but transcript shows `tool_count=2` — transcript truth refutes ship-report. Recovery: investigate via JSONL trace + revisit ship; same shape as `git diff` OVER.
Z:\claude-sota\.claude\rules\synthesis-layer-verify.md:41:- **UNDER (transcript surfaces unreported tool-errors)**: agent's report doesn't mention errors but transcript shows `tool_errors > 0` — agent encountered failures it suppressed. Z:\claude-sota\.claude\rules\synthesis-layer-verify.md:42:- **HONEST-NON-FINDING (transcript empty / parse failure)**: `parse_status != "ok"` — transcript missing or unparseable. Recovery: HNF disposition; do NOT re-spawn agent on the assumption transcript exists; treat axis as closed-without-finding.
Z:\claude-sota\.claude\rules\synthesis-layer-verify.md:52:## Reporting categories — OVER, UNDER, HONEST-NON-FINDING
Z:\claude-sota\.claude\rules\synthesis-layer-verify.md:58:| **OVER** | Report claims more than git shows (claimed edit reverted; claimed file absent) | `git reflog` + infrastructure event log; investigate before re-spawn or commit |
Z:\claude-sota\.claude\rules\synthesis-layer-verify.md:59:| **UNDER** | Report claims less than git shows (claimed nothing, file landed; partial credit) | `git diff` to surface the orphan change; accept work + correct report → commit |
Z:\claude-sota\.claude\rules\synthesis-layer-verify.md:60:| **HONEST-NON-FINDING** | Report says "I probed for X, found nothing" — when the brief assumed X exists | Pivot ship — DROP / REDIRECT / amend brief. The HNF IS the deliverable; do NOT re-spawn the agent to "find X anyway" |
